intro.text: «Несмотря на…» и «хотя…» — по-английски две группы слов. Although и even though ставят перед целой фразой с глаголом, despite и in spite of — перед существительным или -ing.

cells: Although it was raining, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
Although she was tired, she kept working.
Despite being tired, she kept working.
Although he is rich, he isn't happy.
In spite of his money, he isn't happy.

rules.name: although
rules.example: Although I like him, I don't trust him.

rules.name: though
rules.suffix: то же, разговорно; можно в конце
rules.example: It's expensive. I'll buy it, though.

rules.name: even though
rules.example: Even though he studied, he failed.

rules.name: despite the fact that
rules.example: Despite the fact that it rained, we went out.

practice.en: [Although] it was late, we kept talking.
practice.ru: Хотя было поздно, мы продолжали разговаривать.

practice.en: [Despite] the cold, we went for a walk.
practice.ru: Несмотря на холод, мы пошли гулять.

practice.en: [In spite of] feeling ill, she went to work.
practice.ru: Несмотря на плохое самочувствие, она пошла на работу.

practice.en: [Even though] he practised a lot, he lost.
practice.ru: Хотя он много тренировался, он проиграл.

practice.en: [Despite] being tired, he finished the report.
practice.ru: Несмотря на усталость, он закончил отчёт.

practice.en: The food was good. It was expensive, [though].

intro.text: Самые частые ошибки с despite и although.

errors.wrong: Despite it was raining, we went out.
errors.right: Although it was raining, we went out.

errors.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
errors.right: Despite the rain, we went out.

errors.wrong: In spite the rain, we went out.
errors.right: In spite of the rain, we went out.

errors.wrong: Although the rain, we went out.
errors.right: Despite the rain, we went out.

errors.wrong: Although it was cold, but we swam.
errors.right: Although it was cold, we swam.

callout.title: Не ставь but
callout.text: По-русски «хотя…, но…» — нормально. По-английски although и but в одной фразе не дружат: выбери одно.

quote.text: Despite — без of, in spite — с of.
quote.author: правило большого пальца
